description: Consulting-firm invoice intake: verify HMAC events, vision/extract AgentKit sessions, Pulse intake-sweep. KEAP row counts live in face Books, not wing.db.

panels.title: Invoice verify audits (7d)
panels.description: HMAC table.upsert events from invoice-verify CLI and the face Books queue. Empty is an empty table, not a green panel.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE type = 'table.upsert' AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events WHERE type = 'table.upsert' AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

panels.title: Vision/extract sessions (7d)
panels.description: AgentKit sessions for invoice-vision-ocr and invoice-extract.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM agent_sessions WHERE agent_name IN ('invoice-vision-ocr', 'invoice-extract') AND started_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM agent_sessions WHERE agent_name IN ('invoice-vision-ocr', 'invoice-extract') AND started_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')

panels.title: Intake-sweep declared
panels.description: Whether pulse_jobs still lists invoice-vision-base:intake-sweep. Zero means the catalog lost the job.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pulse_jobs WHERE id = 'invoice-vision-base:intake-sweep' AND removed_at IS NULL
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pulse_jobs WHERE id = 'invoice-vision-base:intake-sweep' AND removed_at IS NULL

panels.title: Intake-sweep runs (24h)
panels.description: pulse_runs for the intake sweep. A declared job with zero runs has gone quiet.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pulse_runs WHERE job_id = 'invoice-vision-base:intake-sweep' AND fired_at >= datetime('now', '-24 hours')
targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM pulse_runs WHERE job_id = 'invoice-vision-base:intake-sweep' AND fired_at >= datetime('now', '-24 hours')

panels.title: Recent invoice-pipeline sessions
panels.description: Last 50 AgentKit sessions for the two invoice one-shot agents.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT started_at, agent_name, status, outcome_result, tokens_input, tokens_output FROM agent_sessions WHERE agent_name IN ('invoice-vision-ocr', 'invoice-extract') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT started_at, agent_name, status, outcome_result, tokens_input, tokens_output FROM agent_sessions WHERE agent_name IN ('invoice-vision-ocr', 'invoice-extract') ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Recent table.upsert events
panels.description: Approve/onboard path (CLI + face BFF) writes this type.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts, source, actor_id, type FROM events WHERE type = 'table.upsert' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT ts, source, actor_id, type FROM events WHERE type = 'table.upsert' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50
